name: Reparations
source:
You're a student at an all white school. You have a very close relationship with all your family members, who are blood related. Recently, president Tyrone Washington has passed a series of Reparation laws that may upend your idyllic existence. Only time will tell how his program of Reparations will impact your life.
​
[From F95Zone]
translation:
你是一所全白人学校的学生。你与所有有血缘关系的家庭成员都有非常密切的关系。最近，蒂龙·华盛顿总统通过了一系列赔偿法，这可能会颠覆你田园诗般的生活。只有时间才能证明他的赔偿计划将如何影响你的生活。
​
[来自F95Zone]
